newsitem.title: CHINA: China Communications Bank assets 397.883 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Communications Bank assets 397.883 bln yuan.

text.p: China's Bank of Communications made nearly 40 billion yuan in gross profit between 1986 and 1996, with its assets valued at 397.883 billion yuan at the end of last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The Shanghai-based bank, one of China's 10 authorised channels for overseas capital, has raised $270 million in Singapore and 12 billion yen in Japan through issuing bonds, it said.

The bank's rapidly expanding overseas business has brought its foreign currency assets up to 30 percent of the total in 1996, and hard currency profits accounted for one-quarter of the gross total, Xinhua said.
Total deposits topped 251 billion yuan last year, against outstanding loans of more than 179.1 billion yuan, it added.
The bank has branches in Hong Kong, New York, Tokyo and Singapore and representative offices in London and Frankfurt, Xinhua said.
